title: Joe Wynn's nickname and her second husband
summary: Joe Wynn was nicknamed Windy; her second husband was Leonel Lewis, called Buddy.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: You mentioned, talking about the band back home, a man named Joe Wynn, and then on the tape we did over you referred to Windy Joe Wynn.
Well, they called -- that was a nickname.
Okay. And your husband -- second husband's last name was Lewis, but what was his first name?
His name was Leonel. They all called him Buddy. Buddy was his nickname.
